create_artifact_image: create an ImageArtifact from a PIL Image to wrap it with type and file extension metadata
create_artifact_video: create a VideoArtifact from a list of PIL Images to wrap video frames with type and file extension metadata
build_artifact_dataclass: build an Artifact dataclass instance with type, value, and file_extension fields
test_image_artifact: test the ImageArtifact class to verify it sets type to image and file_extension to png
test_video_artifact: test the VideoArtifact class to verify it sets type to video and file_extension to mp4
